title: Cosmo Clash
description:
Cosmo Clash is a neon style homage to the classics of the arcade - reborn as a multiplayer shooter! Compete with your friends, as you blast & dash your way across a galaxy filled with crazy stages, weapons & special moves! Play as one of 4 space faring animals - Hamm, Laiko, Feliz & Bob the Fish.

- Local multiplayer only - 2 to 4 players can join!

- 50+ arenas to duke it out across.

- Upgrades & weapons a plenty - rocket launchers, bow & arrow and bees!

- Multiple modes and settings - Win Count, Score Attack & Free Play!

So charge up your lasers and blow your furry adversaries to smithereens!

Gameplay: Each player start out with 3 ammo! Make every shot count by charging your attacks, or be nimble and dash across the stage in search of powerups! When your opponents run out of lives, you emerge victoriously! 

You can find detailed instructions within the game.

Controls: This is a multiplayer game, and controllers are recommended. Your ship can move, shoot and dash! Hold shoot or dash to charge your attacks.

Players can play on keyboard as well, but beware of cramps! The keyboard controls are as follows: P1: Arrows-Keys to move, Period to Shoot, Comma to Dash. Additional players controls are depicted below.

Development: After some time in Early Access, it's finally time to launch v1.0! While the game is lacking an online mode, there are ways to play online still, mainly using Parsec or Steam Remote! The game started out as a jam collab between Jo-Remi Madsen (Owlboy), Camilla W. Kvalheim, Martin Kvale (Among the Sleep, ++), Frits Olsen (Death's Door), Aleksander Vinter (aka Savant) and animator Robin Eide!
description_short: Play as one of 4 trigger happy animals, in a primal duel for honor and glory! Bring your friends locally, or duke it out on Steam Remote Play! 2 to 4 Players can shoot, dash and bump their way to quick victory! You'll need speed, reflexes and viciousness to be KING of COSMO CLASH!
